- **Buffer Overflow:** The vertex buffer must be checked for capacity during generation.

No floating-point errors during mesh generation.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of blocks in the chunk ($32^3$).
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(N)$ for the chunk data, height maps, and visit arrays.
The vertex buffer size depends on the number of visible faces, typically $O(N)$ in the worst case (all faces visible) but significantly less on average.
Suitable for real-time applications with frequent updates.
Only merges faces in the Y direction for X and Z faces, leading to less optimal triangle counts than full greedy meshing.
- **When not to use:** Offline mesh generation where minimal triangle count is prioritized over generation speed.
